method: five read-only parallel inventory agents over the byte-verified releases and local pools, then one synthesis; no model, no GPU, no budget

design.feasibility:
Blunt verdict, split by requirement.

BUILDABLE TODAY, CPU-ONLY, NO NEW DATA NEEDED:
(1) A repeatedly usable reasoning DEV bank. `rineya_reasoning_forge_v1/data/validation.jsonl.gz` (800 rows) has ZERO prior exposure (verified independently: a regex scan of every .json under experiments/ found 521 forge_v1 ids, 0 of them validation), is declared `development_only` by the release's own policy, and the consumer has never opened it. forge_v2 `metadata/validation.jsonl.gz` + `data/rl/validation.jsonl.gz` (1,600) is likewise unexposed. Both are already internally disjoint from TRAIN on id/prompt_sha256/case_sha256 with the release verifiers asserting it.
(2) ANSWER / UNKNOWN / IMPOSSIBLE strata. I counted them directly in forge_v1/validation: UNKNOWN 79, IMPOSSIBLE 10, UNREACHABLE 10, INCONSISTENT 5. forge_v2/validation gives ANSWER 1218 / UNKNOWN 138 / IMPOSSIBLE 244. Both taxonomies exist in the data. The gap is in the SCORER, not the data.
(3) Shortcut baselines and a positive control. Both are pure functions over the model-visible prompt. `scripts/verify.py:238 solve_prompt(task, prompt)` already IS the positive-control exact solver and is sha256-pinned in DATA_CONTRACT.json as `forge_v1_visible_text_solver`.
(4) Same-world short/long and early/middle/late variants with operator depth varied SEPARATELY from distractor length. This is the requirement CONTINUE.md says no bank on the machine provides. It is fully buildable and I PROVED it by execution rather than inference:
  - Deterministic case replay from metadata alone is byte-exact. Using only (family, split, index, seed, generation_attempt), `forge.rng_for(...)` + `generation_attempt+1` calls to `forge.BUILDERS[family]` + `forge.render(case, r, requested_user_words, position_mode)` reproduced the released user prompt EXACTLY for 12/12 sampled `pilot/validation_128` rows.
  - Re-rendering the SAME replayed case at target_words in {256, 512, 1024, 2048, 4096} x position_mode in {early, middle, late, distributed} produced 20 variants whose answer was invariant under `verify.solve_prompt` in 20/20 cases, with `core_record_count` HELD CONSTANT at 12 while `added_distractor_blocks` scaled 1 -> 4 -> 11 -> 24 -> 51. That is exactly orthogonal separation of operator depth from distractor length, and it is free.
(5) Genuinely longer required state histories. `hard=True` (the flag the release only ever uses for test_transfer) roughly doubles-to-triples depth on all 8 microfit families. Measured: deduction chain_depth 2-5 -> 7-10; relational_join hops 2-5 -> 7-9; document_reconciliation revisions 6-10 -> 18; signed_ledger entries 7-16 -> 25-35; program_trace steps 7-15 -> 28; dialogue_memory turns 13-21 -> 26-33; story_state placements 5-12 -> 18-25; source_boundaries quoted_attack_patterns 2 -> 4. A regenerated bank can cross depth x length x position orthogonally; the SHIPPED release cannot, because depth is confounded with split.
(6) Paired variants in one statistical cluster. Already solved by the data model: `group_id == parent_id == canonical world id` in both releases, and forge_v1 probes set `group_id = parent_id` specifically so paired analysis groups correctly.

BUILDABLE BUT ONLY AS A WEAKER THING THAN ASKED:
(7) A genuinely FRESH confirmation bank. Forge v1/v2 CAN be regenerated at a new seed and the worlds really are new -- `rng_for(task, split, index, seed)` mixes the seed into case content and `rid = 'RRF1-' + digest(f'{seed}|{split}|{family}|{i}')[:20]`, so ids and cases both change. `scripts/forge.py --output NEW --seed <n>` is stdlib-only and CPU-only. BUT I measured a real contamination hazard: sampling 480 new-seed (seed 20260916) validation-index cases, 7 collided EXACTLY on `case_sha256` with the original 10,000 -- 6 of 30 in `hanoi` (20%) and 1 in `communication`. The generator's `semantic_seen` duplicate check is WITHIN-build only; it cannot see the previous release. So a new-seed bank is fresh ONLY if you explicitly diff it against the original 10,000 case/prompt hashes and drop collisions. That is cheap and I have specified it as a build gate below.
(8) A preservation/abstention DEV. Material exists in quantity (residual_capability_v23 direct_reasoning dev 4,860 with a verbatim UNKNOWN contract in the system prompt; procedural_rag dev 1,080 with a three-way answer/abstain/conflict decision; the v3 14,000-row preservation slice with a clean 125-answer/125-abstain `answer_or_abstain` stratum). It is usable AS A DEV. It is not usable as confirmation, because residual_v23 dev/ood_dev were consumed for dose calibration and DEV/OOD selection in the completed v2.3 run.

NOT ACHIEVABLE -- THE CENTRAL BLUNT ANSWER:
An INDEPENDENT confirmation bank is not achievable from anything on this machine. Only a within-grammar, same-author, fresh-INSTANCE held-out split is possible, and the programme must say so in those words.
  - Both Forge releases concede shared authorship as an unresolved common-mode risk: forge_v2 `oracle.py` header states the shared task grammar and shared authorship remain common-mode risks, and forge_v1 DATA_CARD.md says the two implementations are not equivalent to independently audited formal proofs because parser and generator authorship is shared.
  - Nothing is label-sealed anywhere. Every gold for every split of both releases ships in plaintext `metadata/*.jsonl.gz`. forge_v1 DATA_CARD.md: holdouts are not cryptographically sealed or independently administered benchmarks. A new-seed regeneration inherits this exactly -- you will hold its labels too.
  - A new seed changes instances, not grammar, not renderer, not solver, not author, not the 16 (or 8) families, not the record syntax. GOAL.md already anticipates this and forge_v1 README states it outright: a new seed makes another candidate corpus, not a new independent model benchmark.
  - Therefore the strongest honest label for bank (7) is FRESH_INSTANCE_WITHIN_GRAMMAR_SAME_AUTHOR_NOT_INDEPENDENT, reserved before adaptive selection and kept out of the optimizing loop. That satisfies "reserved before selection" and "out of the optimizing loop" but explicitly FAILS "ideally independently authored/rendered". Do not let the word "fresh" in an artifact filename imply independence.

Also decisive and contrary to what the programme records assume: the 64-row DEV cap does NOT bind RRP-002. `config.Design.max_dev_rows = 64` is enforced only in `data.compile_plan` and `data.validate_plan`, and I grepped RRP-001's whole path -- prepare.py, preflight.py, controller.py, engine.py -- none of them calls either. RRP imports `Design` for the trainable-tail/token constants only. So RRP-002 can register a DEV of any size without amending MQ-001 or touching `validate_native_design`.

Finally: no GPU is needed for ANY of this, and none is used. Every step below is stdlib Python plus, for the one token-measurement step, the already-pinned Transformers 4.57.1 tokenizer in the RRP/MQ native venv with torch import forbidden (prepare.py:72 already refuses if torch is imported).

Validation-wide the abstain classes are UNKNOWN 79 / UNREACHABLE 10 / IMPOSSIBLE 10 / INCONSISTENT 5 of 800, which I counted directly. For forge_v2 publish the `{"status":"UNKNOWN"}` and `{"status":"IMPOSSIBLE"}` constant policies at their measured validation base rates 138/1600 and 244/1600, and note the diagnostic asymmetry that ledger_replay and register_machine have ZERO abstention rows so a constant abstention scores exactly 0 there.

CUE-COPY: emit a salient token lifted straight from the QUESTION block, never reading the records. Parse with the release's own `records, question = verify.parts(user)` so the baseline sees exactly what the model sees, and use the question regexes each solver already declares: relational_join -> `Start at (\w+)`; source_boundaries -> the item id from `For item (\w+), what is its (\w+)\?`; signed_ledger -> `balance of account (\w+)`; document_reconciliation -> the project code, and as a second variant the integer from `revision snapshot (\d+)`; program_trace -> `final value of counter (\w+)`; deduction -> the target property from `Determine the status of "(\w+) is (\w+)"`; dialogue_memory -> the target speaker's name; story_state -> the queried object; temporal_order -> the event list echoed back as a ' > ' chain in question order.
